summary: Opened a sourced recovery/history finding in the captured EPaxos package: startRecoveryForInstance overwrites the recovering replica's value ballot with its freshly tried ballot and injects a self PrepareReply carrying it, so the adoption loop in handlePrepareReply skips genuine replies at the real value ballot and sub-case 6 calls startPhase1 with NOOP even though the reply set carries the accepted value. Recorded six source ranges, two behavior entries (the fabricated self-reply; the ballot-gated adoption), an active question with discriminator, the open reachability premise as a necessary gap, and a question-level conditional interpretation (defect_claim asserted) with counterevidence and limits. No execution this turn: the in-process multi-replica probe harness (5 replicas, marshal-boundary message capture, crash window at the accept phase) is not yet written; that remains the next judgment-changing step.
